description: This file defines the RetrieveConnection class, a final immutable command class for retrieving a Connection object in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors.

classes.name: RetrieveConnection
classes.description: Final immutable command class for retrieving a specific Connection by its ConnectionId within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Extends AbstractCommand and implements ConnectivityQueryCommand.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RetrieveConnection instance with specified ConnectionId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveConnection instance from a JSON string or object, with specified headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the connection ID to the JSON payload, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
